name: Black Whale 1
description: Vaisseau semi-submersible colossal en forme de baleine noire, comptant 41 ponts et pouvant accueillir 200 000 passagers.

name: Zodiac HQ
description: Headquarters of the Zodiacs, secret organization of the 12 most powerful members of the Hunters Association.

name: Tier 1
description: Panopticon Summit and Royal Arena. Hosts the Kakin Royal Family, V5/V6 politicians, industrial leaders, Beyond Netero, Kurapika.

name: Banquet Hall
description: Public gathering space, location of the departure ceremony and mandatory Sunday dinners.

name: VVIP Living Quarters
description: Tier 1 VVIP residential neighborhoods, where the leaders of mafia families linked to royalty live in particular.

name: VIP Casino
description: Casino reserved for Tier 1 passengers. The real Hisoka plays SQ-X there on the eleventh day of the trip.

name: Supreme Court
description: Highest jurisdiction on the ship, managed by Supreme Magistrate Cleapatro.

name: VIP Jail
description: Supreme Court high security VVIP incarceration area. Camilla was confined there.

name: VVIP Prison (Beyond Netero)
description: High security cell holding Beyond Netero, monitored by the Zodiacs.

name: Royal Residential Sector
description: Vast central artery serving the 14 luxurious suites of the princes of Kakin.

name: Room 1001 (Benjamin)
description: Transformed into a paramilitary command center by 1st Prince Benjamin.

name: Room 1002 (Camilla)
description: Plot space of the 2nd Princess Camilla.

name: Room 1003 (Zhang Lei)
description: Coordination center with the Xi-Yu mafia forces, managed by the 3rd Prince Zhang Lei.

name: Room 1004 (Tserriednich)
description: Occult laboratory of the 4th Prince Tserriednich, undergoing temporal and perceptual distortions.

name: Room 1005 (Tubeppa)
description: Analysis laboratory for the 5th Princess Tubeppa.

name: Room 1006 (Tyson)
description: Safe room of the 6th Princess Tyson.

name: Room 1007 (Luzurus)
description: Base of the Cha-R mafia family affiliated with the 7th Prince Luzurus.

name: Room 1008 (Salé-salé)
description: Permanent party zone of the 8th Prince Salé-salé.

name: Room 1009 (Halkenburg)
description: Fortification of the supporters of the 9th Prince Halkenburg.

name: Room 1010 (Kacho)
description: Chamber of the 10th Princess Kacho, anchor point of a network of space tunnels.

name: Room 1011 (Fugetsu)
description: Room of the 11th Princess Fugetsu from where her dimensional escapes operate.

name: Room 1012 (Momoze)
description: Crime scene of the 12th Princess Momoze.

name: Room 1013 (Marayam)
description: Major architectural anomaly. The entire room was ripped from the ship's physical reality by a Beast of Nen, creating a parallel dimension for the 13th Prince Marayam.

name: Room 1014 (Woble)
description: Stronghold of resistance led by Kurapika for the 14th Princess Woble.

name: Tier 2
description: Home to the aristocracy, celebrities, financial elite and supportive Hunters.

name: Heil-Ly Secret Hideout
description: Morena and the new Heil-Ly's true secret base, built in a hidden space between Tiers 2 and 3 and reinforced with Nen. It has five access points.

name: Theater Venue
description: Place of official announcements and propaganda to maintain the illusion of a peaceful cruise.

name: Ministry of Justice
description: Five-story structure constituting the ship's most neutral jurisdiction.

name: VIP Witness Protection Area
description: Impenetrable complex where Melody and Fugetsu were detained and interrogated.

name: Tier 2 Bulkhead
description: Colossal watertight bulkhead separating Tier 2 from Tier 3. Can only be unlocked from Tier 2.

name: Tier 3
description: Hosts upper middle class, medical personnel and the Zodiacs. Administrative buffer zone.

name: Political Ward
description: Central section bringing together law enforcement agencies.

name: Central Police Station
description: Four-story building under the authority of Mizaistom Nana, incorporating dormitories for officers.

name: Central Courthouse
description: Managed by Botobai Gigante, handling civil crimes with the assistance of popular juries.

name: Royal Army Office
description: Base of operations for regular military patrols sent to the Lower Tiers.

name: Central Hospital
description: State-of-the-art medical facility on the ship.

name: Room 3101 (Heil-Ly Hideout)
description: Lair of the Heil-Ly mafia family, perverted by Nen traps.

name: Tier 4
description: Dense residential area, merchants and lower class. Territories disputed by the Cha-R and Xi-Yu mafias.

name: Cha-R Headquarters
description: Large warehouse fortified by the Cha-R family, equipped with armored doors and a network of cameras.

name: Tier 5
description: Lowest class, precarious dormitories. Starting point for the Phantom Troupe's hunt for Hisoka.

name: Central Cafeteria
description: Gigantic central refectory. Rallying place of the Phantom Troupe.

name: Tier 5 Medical Clinic
description: Only Tier 5 clinic, under-equipped and without dedicated doctors.

name: Central Passage Tier 4–5
description: Central passage connecting Tiers 4 and 5. Chrollo, Shizuku and Bonolenov progress there on the fourth day of the journey.

name: Central Dining Hall
description: Crowded central mess hall of Tier 5. Franklin waits for Hisoka there while the Brigade uses it as an assembly point.

name: Recycling & Sewage Facilities
description: Large technical room located between Tiers 4 and 5, dedicated to recycling and wastewater treatment. The Brigade discovers a clandestine route linked to Heil-Ly operations.

name: Tier 3 Residential Units
description: Tier 3 residential units offered in Illumi and Kalluto by Mizaistom in order to house them and facilitate their surveillance.

name: Tier 5 Standard Cabins
description: Standard cabins in the popular Tier 5 area. Machi is located there alone after the Brigade's dispersal.
